commits.body:
Pass CLAUDE_MAX_COST_PER_REQUEST (default $5, production $2) as
max_budget_usd to ClaudeAgentOptions, giving SDK-level defense-in-depth
against runaway request costs. This is separate from the existing
claude_max_cost_per_user lifetime budget in the rate limiter.

Closes #51 (Finding 4)

commits.subject: Add outbound image support: auto-detect and send images to Telegram
commits.body:
When Claude generates or reads image files (charts, slides, diagrams),
automatically detect them and send as Telegram photos/albums instead of
just text references to file paths.

Images are detected from two sources: response text (regex matching paths
in backticks, quotes, markdown syntax, bare paths) and tool call inputs
(Read/Write/Edit of image files). When the response fits in a caption
(≤1024 chars), text and images are combined into a single message;
otherwise text is sent first followed by a grouped album.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: Add MCP send_image_to_user tool for outbound image delivery
commits.body:
Replace regex-based auto-detection with an explicit MCP tool that Claude
calls when it wants to send an image to the user. The stream callback
intercepts send_image_to_user tool calls, validates paths against the
approved directory, and delivers images as Telegram photos/documents.

- Add src/mcp/telegram_server.py (FastMCP stdio server with send_image_to_user tool)
- Add validate_image_path() for secure path validation (boundary + symlink checks)
- Intercept MCP tool calls in stream callbacks (orchestrator + classic handler)
- Remove regex/tool-scan auto-detection (extract_images_from_response)
- Remove image_paths from AgentResponseEvent and notification service
- Add config/mcp.example.json, gitignore config/mcp.json

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: Fix bot stopping mid-response when progress message deletion fails
commits.body:
The progress_msg.delete() call was unprotected in all agentic handlers
(text, document, photo). If it throws (Telegram timeout, rate limit,
message already deleted), the exception crashes the handler and the
actual Claude response is never sent to the user. Wrap all three
call sites in try-except so a deletion failure is logged but does
not prevent delivering the response.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: Add OpenAI Whisper as alternative voice transcription provider
commits.body:
Support both Mistral Voxtral and OpenAI Whisper for voice message
transcription. New VOICE_PROVIDER setting ('mistral' default, 'openai')
auto-selects the right API client and default model. Adds OPENAI_API_KEY
config field and updates feature flags, registry, and tests accordingly.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.body:
Telegram omits `message_thread_id` for messages in the built-in General
topic of forum supergroups, causing `_extract_message_thread_id` to
return None. The routing guard then rejects these messages.

Default to thread ID 1 (Telegram's canonical General topic ID) when no
thread ID is present and the chat is a forum group.

Closes #109
